photos.c: Above: Brendan Reilly relaxes after a tussle with Dalton Grant at the Guardian Insurance Gold Cup Final at Stoke.
A late qualifier for the 'Europeans', Brendan Reilly had to settle for =9th in the high jump final after shooting for 2.32m and a top five position.
Brendan Reilly switched to the colours of Ireland and took the Irish high jump record to 2.29m at the World Champs. in Seville.
Brendan Reilly equalled Ben Challenger's winning height at the AAA but took the silver on countback. Bren went on to compete in Sydney as a member of the Irish team
